title: Surah az-Zalzalah: The Day the Earth Confesses

segments.text: The ground you are standing on right now... is keeping records. And the Qur'an says that one Day, it will report everything it saw.
This is Surah az-Zalzalah. The Earthquake.
segments.title: AZ-ZALZALAH
segments.titleSub: the ninety-ninth surah of the Qur'an

segments.text: Eight verses. It opens with the last morning the world will ever see. When the earth is shaken... with its final earthquake.
And the earth discharges its burdens. Everything it has been holding... the dead it swallowed, the secrets buried in it... given up at once.
And man, standing on the one thing that was always solid, says... what is wrong with it? The most stable thing in every human life... the ground... in revolt.
Then the verse this whole surah turns on. That Day, it will report its news... because your Lord has inspired it. The earth, watching all along... called as a witness to the stand.
Every place you have ever stood was a location with a memory. The floor where you prayed. The room where you lied. The street where you gave... or took. On that Day, the venues themselves speak.
And the surah ends with the finest scale ever described. So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it... and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

The Prophet, peace be upon him, was once asked whether any revelation had come down about donkeys... of all things. And he answered that nothing had come down about them except one unique, comprehensive verse... the verse you just heard.

An atom's weight. Nothing you do is too small to be filed... and nothing too small to be repaid. You are leaving testimony in the ground behind you, everywhere you walk. Make it evidence for you... not against you.
